title: Kiosk Sign-In Assistant configuration
description: Set per organizational unit in the Google Admin console. Nothing here is baked into the extension package, so credentials can differ per store and be rotated without republishing.

username.title: Username
username.description: Account to sign in with. Use a dedicated, view-only, per-store account.

password.title: Password
password.description: Password for the account above. Readable by anyone who can reach the device's policy, so treat it as a low-privilege shared secret, never a personal or admin credential.

autoSubmit.title: Submit the form automatically
autoSubmit.description: If false, fields are filled but a person must click sign in. Useful while testing.

rememberMe.title: Tick the 'remember me' checkbox
rememberMe.description: Kiosk sessions keep their storage between reboots, so a long-lived session cookie is what stops the device needing to sign in every morning. Leave this on.

rememberMeSelector.title: 'Remember me' checkbox CSS selector
rememberMeSelector.description: Optional override. Leave empty to auto-detect.

maxAttempts.title: Maximum sign-in attempts per boot
maxAttempts.description: Guards against an incorrect password causing an endless retry loop that locks the account out across the whole fleet. Keep this low.

usernameSelector.title: Username field CSS selector
usernameSelector.description: Optional override. Leave empty to auto-detect. Set this if the login page changes and auto-detection stops working - it avoids rebuilding the extension.

passwordSelector.title: Password field CSS selector
passwordSelector.description: Optional override. Leave empty to auto-detect.

submitSelector.title: Submit button CSS selector
submitSelector.description: Optional override. Leave empty to auto-detect.

successSelector.title: Post-login success CSS selector
successSelector.description: Optional. An element that only exists once signed in. If set, the extension stops retrying as soon as it appears.

errorSelector.title: Login error CSS selector
errorSelector.description: Optional. An element shown when credentials are rejected. If set, the extension stops immediately rather than burning through attempts.

debug.title: Verbose logging
debug.description: Logs decisions to the console. Only useful with kiosk troubleshooting tools enabled.
